name: game_compat
description: Query a game's compatibility on Linux. A single call concurrently aggregates three sources: ProtonDB ratings and player reports, AreWeAntiCheatYet anti-cheat status (Supported/Running/Planned/Broken/Denied), and a caniplayonlinux verdict snapshot. Accepts a Steam App ID (numeric) or a game name; Chinese game names can be queried directly. Returns Markdown. Content is parsed live from third-party sites: treat any field not returned as unknown and do not fabricate it; a missing source does not mean a negative verdict.

query.description: Steam App ID or game name.

max_reports.description: Number of ProtonDB reports, default 8, max 40. Use 0 for the verdict only, without reports.
